snippet.title: Under Destruction - Official Pre-Alpha Trailer | Fight for Machine Supremacy!
snippet.description:
Prepare for the ultimate battle in a dystopian future where machines rule the Earth!
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3359410/Under_Destruction/

In Under Destruction, you take on the role of Spyro, an elite combat drone tasked with conquering humanity's last defenses and securing the precious Erythonite. With fully destructible environments, strategic open-world gameplay, and heart-pounding battles, this is not just a game—it’s a war for machine supremacy.

Key Features:

Total Destruction: Tear through barricades, fortifications, and enemy turrets with advanced weaponry.
Strategic Open World: Explore mountainous terrains, capture Erythonite refineries, and fortify your bases.
Intense Combat: Face off against jets, tanks, helicopters, and more in high-octane battles.
Multiplayer Madness: Join friends in Battle Royale or Survival-Coop modes for thrilling team-based gameplay.
Will you lead the machines to victory, or will humanity fight back harder than ever?

Coming 2025. Every decision matters. Every shot counts. Join the war for the future today!
